keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: the land held by the rebel governors Molon (Media) and his brother Alexander (Persis) in 222-221. The Antiochus III page names Media and Persis only; it does not name Babylonia or give an area, and the rebels' seat is not on the page. Cliopatria has no row for the revolt.

certainty.note: The extent of the rebel domain is the two provinces the page names; no frontier is given.

notes: Rebel state added by me-05-c (group scope: states Cliopatria lacks). One page (Antiochus III the Great) names the revolt, so the dossier is minimal: no capital is named (capitals left empty), Babylonia is not mentioned, and the rebels' fate beyond 'collapsed' is not on the page. The Seleucid Empire dossier carries the matching loss (222) and gain (221). Reviewer me-05-c (2026-10-19): every Media region is clipped to exclude Atropatene (independent under Artabazanes until Antiochus III's attack in 221), so the rebel domain is Seleucid Media and Persis only.
